# IAMMCQWORY

> The portfolio and studio practice of Makori Brian, a Nairobi-based founder, filmmaker, and AI strategist. IAMMCQWORY builds AI-powered operating infrastructure, media brands, and creative ventures for African founders building globally.

## Primary profile

- [IAMMCQWORY homepage](https://iammcqwory.vercel.app/): Founder. Filmmaker. AI Strategist. Services, ventures, creative work, and contact details. (~850 tokens)
- [AI-readable profile](https://iammcqwory.vercel.app/index.md): Clean Markdown version of the homepage for research, briefs, and AI-assisted discovery. (~900 tokens)
- [Creative services](https://iammcqwory.vercel.app/creative#packages): Photography, cinematography, live performance coverage, artist content, campaign assets, hospitality storytelling, and short-form reels by Makori Brian in Nairobi. (~650 tokens)
- [Sitemap](https://iammcqwory.vercel.app/sitemap): Human-readable site map for the portfolio, ventures, creative work, and contact routes. (~250 tokens)

## Core services

- Business systems audits and AI strategy consulting in Nairobi: Find the operational bottleneck, map the system, and create a practical roadmap for founders and SMEs.
- Workflow automation and AI agents: Build lightweight automations, agents, integrations, and data pipelines for small-business operations.

## Ventures

- [Waziri Collective Labs](https://waziricollectivelabs.vercel.app/): AI strategy and automation for founders and SMEs. "We don't pitch AI transformation. We find the thing breaking your operation and fix it." (~120 tokens)
- [Mamabora](https://mamabora.lovable.app/): AI-powered parenting support for mothers and caregivers, with expert guidance, milestone tracking, and instant support. (~85 tokens)
- [The Nairobi Post](https://thenairobipost.vercel.app/): Culture and business media property focused on editorial packaging, publishing cadence, and distribution loops. (~80 tokens)
- [GitUliza](https://gituliza.vercel.app/): Repository intelligence for understanding codebases faster. (~45 tokens)
- [Vijanabora](https://vijanabora.vercel.app/): Youth mental health advocacy rooted in Kenya and wider African contexts. (~45 tokens)
- [ThinkBora](https://thinkbora.vercel.app/): Data, AI, and business innovation training through live client projects. (~65 tokens)
